import os
import pathlib
import subprocess

source = pathlib.Path('snapshot.go')
fixed = source.read_bytes()
env = dict(os.environ, GOPROXY='off', GOSUMDB='off')
try:
    source.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:snapshot.go']))
    result = subprocess.run(['go', 'test', '-race', '-run', '"'^TestRaft_(ApplyConcurrent_Timeout|LeaderLeaseExpire|LeadershipTransferLeaderRejectsClientRequests)$'"', '-count=1', '-timeout=30s', '.'], env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        if line.startswith(('--- FAIL:', 'FAIL', 'ok ')) or 'case 5:' in line or 'should step down' in line:
            print(line)
    print('Unchanged-code test exit status:', result.returncode)
finally:
    source.write_bytes(fixed)
PY"
